description: Download a published credit note as a PDF file to savePath. Returns the written path and byte count.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

creditNoteId.description: Id from bokio_list_credit_notes; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

savePath.description: File path inside BOKIO_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the working directory; an existing file is never overwritten, so pick a new name.

name: bokio_download_credit_note
